standard.summary: 控制 torch.compile 的执行策略。off 不编译；compile 标准编译；compile_cache 编译并缓存；cudagraph 使用 CUDA Graph 录制回放。
standard.effect: compile_cache 在首次编译后将产物持久化，后续启动直接加载。cudagraph 在固定 shape 场景下额外提速 10-20%。
standard.whenToUse: compile_cache 是推荐的编译模式。cudagraph 在 DiT 模型（Anima/Newbie）上效果最好。
standard.avoidWhen: cudagraph 与动态 shape（bucket 多分辨率）不兼容——需要 compile_shape_strategy 配合。

optionDescriptions.off: 不 compile，启动痛快，稳态往往慢。
optionDescriptions.compile: 正常 compile，第一次慢，后面常快。
optionDescriptions.compile_cache: 编完存盘，下次少编一遍。
optionDescriptions.cudagraph: CUDA Graph 回放；shape 得固定，多分辨率容易挂。
optionDescriptions.compile_cudagraph: compile 和 cudagraph 叠一起，赚得多限制也多。

standard_en.summary: Governs the torch.compile execution strategy. off does not compile; compile is standard compilation; compile_cache compiles and caches; cudagraph records and replays a CUDA Graph.
standard_en.effect: compile_cache persists the artefact after the first compilation so later launches load it directly. cudagraph adds another 10-20% where shapes are fixed.
standard_en.whenToUse: compile_cache is the recommended compilation mode. cudagraph works best on DiT models (Anima/Newbie).
standard_en.avoidWhen: cudagraph is incompatible with dynamic shapes (multi-resolution buckets) -- it needs compile_shape_strategy alongside it.

optionDescriptions.off: No compile: launches fast, usually slower once steady.
optionDescriptions.compile: Ordinary compile: slow the first time, usually faster after.
optionDescriptions.compile_cache: Saves the compilation to disk so next time it compiles less.
optionDescriptions.cudagraph: CUDA Graph replay; shapes must be fixed, and multiple resolutions break it easily.
optionDescriptions.compile_cudagraph: compile and cudagraph stacked: bigger gain, more restrictions.

advanced.principle: compile: torch.compile 捕获 FX graph → Inductor 编译为 CUDA kernel。compile_cache: 将编译产物保存到 compile_cache_root 目录。cudagraph: 在前几步 warmup 后录制 CUDA Graph，后续直接回放录制的 kernel 序列，消除所有 CPU 端 kernel launch 开销。compile_cudagraph 组合两者。
advanced.intervention: trainer.py 在模型构建后根据 compile_runtime 选择编译策略。
advanced.expectedImpact: compile 提速 10-30%。cudagraph 额外提速 10-20%。总计可达 30-50%。
advanced.tradeoffs: compile_probe_enabled 在训练前做 3 步性能探测，确认加速有效才继续使用。compile_contract_strict 在训练前检查 compile 与当前配置的兼容性。

advanced_en.principle: compile: torch.compile captures the FX graph → Inductor compiles to CUDA kernels. compile_cache: saves compilation artifacts under compile_cache_root. cudagraph: after a few warmup steps, records a CUDA Graph and then replays the recorded kernel sequence, eliminating all CPU-side kernel-launch overhead. compile_cudagraph combines both.
advanced_en.intervention: trainer.py picks the compile strategy per compile_runtime after model construction.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: compile speeds up 10-30%. cudagraph adds 10-20%. Up to 30-50% total.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: compile_probe_enabled runs a 3-step performance probe before training and keeps compiling only if acceleration is confirmed. compile_contract_strict checks compile-vs-config compatibility before training.
